newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - J.P. Morgan buy repeated.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - J.P. Morgan buy repeated.

text.p: -- Friedman, Billings, Ramsey & Co Inc said it reiterated a buy rating on J.P. Morgan & Co Inc

-- Analyst Carla D'Arista said after recording near-record earnings in the first half of 1996, J.P. Morgan's earnings began to dip in the third quarter. FBR said year-to-year, normalized earnings also declined 14 percent, but FBR's projection for full year profits of $7.50 per share, up from $6.42 per share in 1995, remains unchanged. "Not only does our current year profit outlook still represent a 17 percent year-to-year increase, but we suspect that our $8.10 per share estimate for 1997 is conservative," D'Arista said.
